name: tinto-client-itinerary-pdf
description: Building the dated, tour-specific day-by-day itinerary PDF for a tour that's about to sell, being pitched, or already sold, the document the selling client uses to sell the tour and pass on to their own guests. For a repeat destination, reuses that destination's real reference itinerary directly (confirmed as accurate or updated first) rather than drafting each tour's day-by-day from scratch, since most tours to the same destination run an identical or near-identical route under a different client's brand. For a brand-new winery or client, hands off to the tinto-add-winery-record plugin to source branding and file the Airtable record; for a genuinely new tour with no Tours record yet, hands off to the tinto-add-new-tour plugin to create it properly, rather than duplicating either plugin's own research here, so install both alongside this one when either path matters. Split out of tinto-guest-communication so it can be installed on its own, e.g. for Peter, who needs this without the rest of Nélia's daily guest-communication scope.
